claim.value: A small test can produce no detectable effect even when the mechanism being addressed matters.
claim.scope: A possible explanation of an undetectable effect, not a claim about the actual test size or result.

provenance.rationale: P034 explicitly attributes this possibility to a small test.

signal_basis.value: The release test measures the difference in first-publication rates and its uncertainty; a small test may yield no detectable effect.
signal_basis.scope: A hypothetical release-test outcome over the specified follow-up, without asserting that the actual test is small or its result undetectable.

provenance.rationale: P022 supplies the measured signal and uncertainty; P034 supplies the possible small-test outcome.
The claim is supported without an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: A small sample can provide insufficient statistical power to detect a real effect. Thus, an undetectable result is compatible with a mechanism that matters, licensing the claim's limited possibility statement.
uncertainty: This does not establish that sample size explains any particular result or that the mechanism actually matters in this case.
